response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong systems and event-driven development background, but the role centers on deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation with IEC 62443 secure-development practices. His professional C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015; his recent decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang web/platform work, with no evident industrial cybersecurity, MQTT, or industrial protocol experience. The overall profile does not match the core requirements despite adjacent strengths.
strengths: Strong low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, caching, fibers at Dunnhumby)
15+ years of software experience with event-driven architectures, REST APIs, and testing/TDD craftsmanship
Mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, and open-source projects
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++/STL experience (brief role ending in 2015)
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 exposure; no industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Recent career trajectory is full-stack web/AI tooling, not industrial automation or embedded platforms
